media_policy: Only allowlisted generated fully clothed synthetic adults, technical crops, own generated clips, and inspected ComfyUI screenshots. User phone photo and private workflow/media excluded.
text_policy: No local identity/path, GPU UUID, credential pattern or unexpected email found. This is a scoped source/metadata audit, not a guarantee against every possible identifier.
commit_email_policy: Keep existing GitHub account settings and use its default commit identity, as explicitly requested by the account owner after the email privacy choice was explained.
